text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash managed to achieve splendid 
results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we are scheduled to arrive at 
Düsseldorf Airport in 5 days at 13:40.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The paperwork and schedule adjustments 
are all complete. I will assist as well, 
so let us proceed with Trainer's 
preparations."
choice_data_list:
...Could you say that one more time from 
the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Überraschung— It's a surprise, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's go to Germany.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Left speechless by the sudden surprise 
sprung by Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Was that too sudden after all? I had 
considered informing you a year ago, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
According to Falcon-san, she said, "It 
totally has to be a surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to having fun, I figured 
it'd be best to respect her wishes...
choice_data_list: So we made it a surprise format...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I checked Trainer's schedule in 
advance, so the dates shouldn't be an 
issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Between these dates... are you 
free at all?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. I'd like to use that time for our 
consultations, so please keep it open as 
is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, that was 
confirmed before. It was so natural that 
it didn't really catch my attention back 
then, but..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Was I being a nuisance?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"From the very beginning three years ago, 
I planned to return to Germany right after 
finishing the race."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, as of right now, I am still 
actively racing. Therefore, I will arrange 
for this to be a temporary trip home—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In addition, one more thing... Although it 
wasn't in our initial plans, we've 
arranged for an escort to accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I found myself wanting to show you my 
beloved hometown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I had intended to plan everything so you 
could enjoy yourself to the fullest before 
departure, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...In the first place, I forgot to ask if 
Trainer-san actually wanted to go on a 
trip."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I just assumed on my own that you'd want 
to go... It's a bad habit of mine.
choice_data_list: Of course I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: I want to see Flash's hometown!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, let's go. To Germany...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Eishin Flash and I began preparing 
for our trip to Germany.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—It might be a bit chilly, so you should 
take a jacket with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, is that all? It seems my parents 
are preparing the rest."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They seem really excited for you to come 
visit, Trainer... I hear they're even 
rearranging the furniture.
choice_data_list: Y-You didn't have to go that far for me...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Now that I've stepped away, I 
understand. My parents aren't as flawless 
as I thought they were.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, striving for perfection and 
actually achieving it... is why I respect 
her."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That may be true. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now, once you've decided what to bring, 
all that's left is packing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please leave this to me. I'll pack it up 
perfectly and neatly for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, preparations for the trip steadily 
progressed—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
âWe have arrived. DÃ¼sseldorf Airport... 
We're in Germany.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you can't be serious. You slept so 
soundly on the plane, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there's no need to be nervous. 
Because I'm here with you."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That concludes it. Do you have any 
concerns?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm glad. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, my parents should be here to pick me 
up, but—

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text: Flash, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah! There you are, Trainer. Come on—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's go!
